name: Hanging knee raise

phases.name: raise
phases.cue: Bring your knees up to your chest

phases.name: hold
phases.cue: Knees above your hips, abs tight

formTips: Hang from the bar with straight arms and your shoulders pulled down
Brace your abs and raise your knees until they're above your hips
Curl your pelvis up a little at the top
Lower your legs slowly and stop the swing before the next rep
commonMistakes: Swinging the body to lift the legs
Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears
